descriptionChirho: Qal: to strike or clap -- the basic physical action of bringing hands together or striking the body; covers clapping in derision (Job 27:23, 34:37), celebration (Nah 3:19), striking hands together in anger (Num 24:10), striking the thigh or chest in grief or anguish (Jer 31:19, Ezek 21:17), and God smiting the wicked (Job 34:26).
Hifil: to clasp or join hands with someone as a gesture of making an alliance or covenant, a distinct social-diplomatic action; used of Israel making pacts with foreigners (Isa 2:6).
Qal: to wallow or splash about in water; a metaphorical extension of the striking/flailing motion, used of wading through rising waters (Ezek 47:2).
